nodes.description: owner address of the Owned contract; initialised to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner address of the Owned contract; pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
public string symbol of the token, set to 'SLVC' in the constructor.
public string name of the token, set to 'SiliconValleyCoin' in the constructor.
public uint8 decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
public uint _totalSupply, the total token supply, set to 1000000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances of every account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition using require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction using require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication using require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by the onlyOwner modifier; stores a pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership() letting the pending newOwner claim ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
SiliconValleyCoin() constructor that sets token metadata, mints the whole supply and emits Transfer.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writing the allowance of msg.sender for spender.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moving tokens using the caller allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) that approves and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) owner-only rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender supplied by the caller; used for ownership checks, balance and allowance bookkeeping.
external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled contract inside approveAndCall.
external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract inside transferAnyERC20Token.
